neighbours.label: a count of time or distance units still left before an end point (N Days Left, the last N minutes, N weeks to go): the 'remaining' side; the + pole fires at the end point itself (hits zero, surrender)
fire: REMINDER: 45 Days Left to register for the spring marathon.
Simmer the sauce for an hour, adding the basil in the last 10 minutes or so.
There are only 9 days left until the school year ends.
FINAL CALL: 30 Days Left to submit your photos to the contest.
Roast the chicken for 90 minutes, basting it in the last 15 minutes or so.
With only 3 days left before the vote, both sides are still campaigning.
NOTICE: 120 Days Left to the start of the summer games.
Grill the corn for 20 minutes, brushing on butter in the last 2 minutes or so.
quiet: REMINDER: 45 runners registered for the spring marathon.
Simmer the sauce for an hour, then stir in the basil and serve.
There are only 9 teachers working at the school this year.
FINAL RESULT: 30 photos were submitted to the contest.
Roast the chicken for 90 minutes, then let it rest on a board.
